title: Repeat Violations — Community Rules & Site Care Rules and Regulations
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a repeat-violation charge is posted only in a community listed as permitting it, and only for a notice that is the second or later in the same rule class within the repeat-violation window after an earlier notice in that class was cured or charged. A repeat-violation charge is posted for such a second or later notice where the community permits such charges.

## Communities and repeat charges

| Community | Repeat-violation charges |
|---|---|
| Willow Bend Estates | not permitted |
| Palmetto Shores | not permitted |
| Saguaro Vista | permitted |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | permitted |
| Cedar Hollow | permitted |
| Conestoga Meadows | not permitted |

## Further provisions

- No repeat charge is posted for a notice withdrawn as the community's responsibility, and withdrawn notices are not counted.
- In a community not permitting repeat charges, repeated violations are enforced only through manager referral.
- The former sentence "the second notice is charged the plan's second-notice repeat charge and each later notice the plan's third-and-later repeat charge" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for repeat-violation charges.

## Hypothetical cases

| Community | Notice | Repeat charge |
|---|---|---|
| Saguaro Vista | second lawn notice within the window, the first having been cured by the resident | posted |
| Conestoga Meadows | second lawn notice within the window | none; enforced only through manager referral |
| Cedar Hollow | first debris notice | none; it is not a second or later notice |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | notice withdrawn as the community's responsibility | none, and the notice is not counted |

superseded_clauses: The second notice is charged repeat_violation_charge_second and each later notice repeat_violation_charge_third_plus.
